about_the_game:
The spaceship racing game where every trajectory and every shot counts! The RIFT is a sci-fi universe blending arcade gameplay with realistic physics. Find the best racing lines, beat your best times, and make your mark on the leaderboard.

Campain

Perfect for challenging the competition. Earn medals and rewards based on your performance. New maps will be added regularly with each update!

Multiplayer

The RIFT features an intense and demanding multiplayer mode. Compete against your friends or players from around the world.

Editor Mode

Unleash your creativity and design your own races. This mode enhances the overall experience by encouraging collaboration and sharing, with dedicated tools and assets made available to players. Ready to build the race of your dreams and challenge your friends on your own creations?

Personalization

Unlock new ships and components. Take your style to the next level. Shine, shine, little diamond—dazzle us!

Contemplation

Beyond racing, The RIFT invites you to slow down with a contemplative mode! Freely explore the arenas and immerse yourself in the game’s landscapes.

short_description: The Rift is a sci-fi arcade game where you pilot a ship with 6 degrees of freedom. The main mode is a race that also integrates shooting mechanics. Dive into a sci-fi universe blending arcade gameplay with realistic physics. Strapped in? Welcome to The Rift!
